name: m7-03-1
title: Optimistic concurrency control with ETag and If-Match
spec:
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    participant A as Playbook A (Your Script)
    participant BMC as Redfish Service (BMC)
    participant B as Playbook B (Colleague)

    A->>BMC: GET /redfish/v1/Systems/System_0
    BMC-->>A: 200 OK (ETag: W/"fbd530fd09c0")
    B->>BMC: PATCH /redfish/v1/Systems/System_0 {"AssetTag": "RACK12-U7"} (If-Match: W/"fbd530fd09c0")
    BMC-->>B: 200 OK (New ETag: W/"abd2bca5dab7")
    A->>BMC: PATCH /redfish/v1/Systems/System_0 {"AssetTag": "OTHER"} (If-Match: W/"fbd530fd09c0")
    BMC-->>A: 412 Precondition Failed (Stale ETag rejected)
    A->>BMC: GET /redfish/v1/Systems/System_0 (Re-read current state)
    BMC-->>A: 200 OK (ETag: W/"abd2bca5dab7", AssetTag: "RACK12-U7")
    A->>BMC: PATCH /redfish/v1/Systems/System_0 (If-Match: W/"abd2bca5dab7")
    BMC-->>A: 200 OK (Update applied safely)

name: m7-04-1
title: The session steps
spec:
sequenceDiagram
    participant C as Client
    participant S as Redfish service
    C->>S: POST /redfish/v1/SessionService/Sessions with UserName and Password
    S-->>C: 201 Created, X-Auth-Token, Location (the session address), Session body
    Note over C: Keep the token secret and keep the Location
    C->>S: GET or PATCH or POST with header X-Auth-Token
    S-->>C: answers
    Note over S: Idle longer than SessionTimeout and the session is closed
    C->>S: DELETE the Location address when finished
    S-->>C: 204 No Content

name: m7-05-1
title: Long jobs: 202 and the task monitor
spec:
sequenceDiagram
    participant C as Client
    participant S as Redfish service
    C->>S: POST the action
    S-->>C: 202 Accepted, Location is the task monitor, Retry-After 2, Task body
    loop until done
        C->>S: GET the task monitor
        S-->>C: 202 Accepted, TaskState Running, PercentComplete
        Note over C: wait about Retry-After seconds
    end
    C->>S: GET the task monitor
    S-->>C: 200 OK with the result the action would have returned
    C->>S: GET the Task resource
    S-->>C: TaskState Completed, EndTime

name: m7-15-2
title: Replacing the certificate through Redfish
spec:
sequenceDiagram
    participant A as Admin tool
    participant B as BMC (Redfish)
    participant C as Your CA
    A->>B: POST GenerateCSR (CommonName, SAN, key size)
    Note over B: BMC makes a NEW private key and keeps it inside
    B-->>A: 200, CSRString (a certificate request)
    A->>C: sign the request
    C-->>A: signed certificate (PEM)
    A->>B: POST ReplaceCertificate (CertificateUri, CertificateString, PEM)
    Note over B: BMC checks the certificate matches its key, then starts using it
    B-->>A: 200
    A->>B: new connection, verified against your CA
